title: Combustion Blade
description: A funny mod based on Rei Ninja Sect meme. Adds Blazing Blade that plays iconic misheard lines on hit, craftable in survival mode to tease your friends.
body:
# Explanation
 
The lex Ninja Sect is a series of internet memes derived from reversed audio misheard clips of videos featuring [[LexBurner]](https://space.bilibili.com/777536?), a well-known Bilibili streamer and online commentator, combined with settings from works such as Naruto and Ninja Slayer.
 
This meme originated from reversed footage of LexBurner’s livestream on December 19, 2022, during which he broke down crying after being accused of emotional infidelity by his ex-wife.
 
The original line "I didn’t do anything wrong except not love you" became the misheard reversed line "You startled me, I’m unleashing my ninja jutsu", which spread wildly across the internet. Netizens spontaneously reinterpreted numerous bizarre, distorted reversed "eldritch speech" audio snippets from the livestream through misheard phonetic translations, and created fan art centered on ninja emojis .

![shaking hands 🤝.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce0067d79e38168ae8a37c9e7e3bd6b30a98c85e_0.webp)
 
# Introduction
 
This mod adds a weapon called the Blazing Blade. Every strike with it plays the powerful line "Slice after slice, Blazing Blade". It also includes survival-mode crafting recipes, perfect for tormenting your friends for shared amusement.
